scope: Preliminary complete construction of a buried pressure HDPE pipeline by open trench on an unpaved route: setting out, excavation, bedding, pipe supply and butt fusion, lowering, surround, backfill, compaction, marking, logistics, quality records and procurement balance.
calculatedScope: trench width and excavation from pipe diameter, clearance, depth and route length
bedding, protective surround, reusable soil backfill, imported fill and excess soil
installed pipe, expected loss, retained spare, stock, supplier segments, order and remainder
butt-fusion joints, consumables, connection kits, end caps, warning tape and detectable wire
survey, excavation, bedding, fusion, laying, backfill, quality labor and mechanisms
pipe and granular-material delivery, excess-soil removal and completion records
conditionalProjectFacts: trench shoring system and supported route length
dewatering pump, pumping duration and discharge rate
excludedScope: permanent valves, hydrants, valve chambers and manholes
hydraulic pressure testing and leak acceptance
flushing, disinfection, laboratory water acceptance and permanent chlorination equipment
road or railway crossings, trenchless installation, pavement restoration and rock excavation
prices or manufacturer performance not supplied by a confirmed source
truthBoundary: This visible preliminary engineering profile is not an approved design, method statement or universal norm. Geometry and arithmetic are automatic; profile coefficients and conditional branches remain editable and require confirmation for the actual project. Pressure testing, flushing/disinfection and permanent appurtenances are separate estimate owners.
